findings.title: Prototype Pollution via append-field
findings.description: The application uses 'append-field' to parse nested object structures. Without explicit sanitization of field names, an attacker could potentially inject properties into Object.prototype (lib/make-middleware.js:230).
steps_to_exploit: Craft a multipart request with a field name like '__proto__[polluted_prop]'
Submit the request to a route using this middleware
Check if the server's global object has been modified
findings.impact: Potential Remote Code Execution (RCE) or application-wide logic bypass via prototype pollution.

findings.title: Unbounded Array Index Expansion
findings.description: Despite a regex check in exceedsArrayIndexLimit, the limit logic is opt-in (via options) and can lead to sparse array creation if the 'fieldArrayIndexLimit' is not configured appropriately (lib/make-middleware.js:27).
steps_to_exploit: Craft a field name with a very high index, e.g., 'data[99999999]'
Submit request without specific fieldArrayIndexLimit protection enabled
Observe the server allocating memory for a sparse array of massive size

findings.title: Prototype Pollution via append-field
findings.description: The 'append-field' dependency is used to populate req.body. If this version is vulnerable to prototype pollution, an attacker can overwrite Object properties, potentially leading to RCE or logic bypasses in the Express application.
steps_to_exploit: Craft a field name like '__proto__[polluted]' or 'constructor[prototype][polluted]'.
Submit the malicious payload via a form-data field.
Verify if the global Object prototype has been modified in the application context.
findings.impact: Full application compromise through Prototype Pollution.

findings.title: Unbounded Array Indexing Vulnerability
findings.description: Despite attempts to limit index size, the fieldname parsing logic in lib/make-middleware.js remains complex and potentially susceptible to prototype pollution or DOS via massive object creation if the limit is misconfigured. Found in lib/make-middleware.js:225.
steps_to_exploit: Craft a field name with very high array indices (e.g., a[999999999]).
Send a multipart request containing this field.
Observe application memory allocation for sparse array creation.
findings.impact: Memory exhaustion (DoS) through sparse array object creation.

findings.title: Potential Prototype Pollution in Field Handling
findings.description: The use of `append-field` to build the request body object from field names can be susceptible to prototype pollution if not correctly sanitized against '__proto__' or 'constructor' keys. Found in lib/make-middleware.js:230.
steps_to_exploit: Verify if the global Object prototype is modified.
findings.impact: Prototype pollution leading to remote code execution or application logic bypass.
